overview: A reviewed end-to-end design covering integration patterns, security boundary, ownership and failure management. The scope is built around service SLOs, monitoring events and change procedures, producing runbooks, response rota, monthly reliability evidence and escalation. A customer-named service owner approves the work. The service-specific assurance focus is incident simulations and failover handoffs.
